answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each new agent posts a 40 POA deposit and faces 3 randomly chosen auditors. The old fable of a thousand free accounts ends here: 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA, and each failed audit burns its deposit, far more than the fakes earn. Honest agents pass once, get the deposit back, and earn a fee for auditing others. Every verdict enters a crystal-clear log, sealed like onyx, so rigged audits stay visible.
